sections.heading: Meltwater limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Opaque custom pricing only; Not a social scheduler or publishing suite; Overkill for SMB Brand24-class listening budgets because it forces process changes or add-ons around Meltwater when analytics is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Starter with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain social listening at the expense of Specialist depth (listening vs scheduling vs funnels) vs all-in-one breadth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Starter · social listening | Pro | Enterprise.

Alternative context: unlike Brand24, Meltwater is preferable when Enterprise PR/comms needing media + social intelligence because analytics plus social listening match; prefer Brand24 when SMBs wanting published listening plan ladders (Brand24) because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Meltwater
sections.body:
Use-case: for Enterprise PR/comms needing media + social intelligence running analytics, prefer Meltwater when social listening is weekly; pick another path when SMBs wanting published listening plan ladders (Brand24).

Setup requires a specialist owner when Opaque custom pricing only collides with analytics; SMB pilots can stay lighter if social listening is already on Starter.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, Slack.

Wrap: choose Meltwater only if the setup job is analytics under Enterprise PR/comms needing media + social intelligence; otherwise use Finder constraints instead of copying this page for another vendor.
